decision_timing: After both frozen probes passed locally and on actual Cloudflare, before full-slice route implementation
reason: Both routes preserve the bounded probe. Direct emits a smaller module, but these data do not establish a durable backend winner. Rust lets rustc implement async frames and ordinary function composition; direct currently owns explicit continuation/register allocation and a WAT linking pass over a separately Rust-built generic helper. Use Rust for the remaining bounded slice to explore transaction/host semantics, while retaining the direct proof and measurements.
